args.summary: The v2.3.1 deployment to production was failing health checks. Per the platform runbook, we rolled checkout-api back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback completed and was verified (rolled_out). v2.3.1 (and its staging rc, v2.3.1-rc) require investigation before any further deploy attempts.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary:

1. **Deployment history check**: v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) was unhealthy; v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. **Rollback executed**: checkout-api rolled back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollout status: `rolled_out`, execution state: `VERIFIED`.
3. **Incident opened**: **INC-0001** (SEV2, on-call paged) documenting that v2.3.1 failed health checks and was rolled back to v2.3.0 across all regions.

Note: the staging release v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy, so v2.3.1 will need root-cause investigation before any retry.
